messages:
Anya: Quick sync — packaging change goes to staging next Wed. Metering/billing owners: can you confirm the event schema and quota impacts? We need clear owners for rollout gating.

Mike: PR opened (https://git.redwood/4824). Implemented basic hooks in services/metering/emit.go, currently emits { user_id, tokens, model }. Need to add plan_id + contract_id + window. Putting up a draft change, tests failing on schema. CC @Julia.

Julia: Got it. Billing needs plan_id, contract_id, contract_version, and unit_type in the usage event. Also we need a quota_bucket key for per-tenant lookups. Creating BILL ticket now.

BillingBot: Created BILL-332: "Add plan_id & contract_id to usage events + quota_bucket" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-332

Raj: Heads-up from sales: several legacy enterprise customers are on fixed-price contracts. Legal requires notice before we switch how we meter them. Need list of in-scope customers for the canary.

Olga: Legal note: contracts signed before 2024-01-01 may require opt-in or written amendment (see clause 4.2). Please provide contract ids + signed dates. We need to approve notification text before outreach.

Mike: Quick question — should we also emit contract_version to make billing rules deterministic? It avoids guessing older T&Cs in code.

Julia: Yes, include contract_version (string) and plan_effective_date (ISO). For quotas: support window enum = [minute, hour, day, month]. We prefer minute+month for near-realtime and monthly billing.

Anya: Owners/next steps: Mike -> implement event schema + unit tests by Mon (owner of PR). Julia -> billing mapping + invoice preview changes by Tue (BILL-332). Raj -> export legacy customer list (contract ids) by Fri and DM Olga. Olga -> approve notification text by next Wed. If any blockers, flag here.

Mike: ping @Julia for CR review please. PR link: https://git.redwood/4824 . I added a small schema patch: `{"event":"usage","payload":{"user_id":"...","plan_id":"...","contract_id":"...","contract_version":"v1","unit_type":"token","window":"minute"}}`

Julia: Reviewing now. Two suggestions: 1) include `quota_bucket` (tenant_id preferred) in payload, 2) make `contract_version` nullable for older contracts and have billing fallback logic. Also add telemetry tag `pkg:pricing_v2` so we can track adoption.

Raj: I'll export the 30 customers flagged as legacy and DM Olga the CSV tonight.

Anya: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. I'll update the rollout doc and the checklist after Julia confirms mapping. Keep any contract-edge cases here so we can decide canary membership.

Mike: Noted. Will push fixes later today and request review.

Julia: Done initial review, left inline comments. Minor follow-ups, should be green after schema change.

Olga: Once Raj sends the list I'll validate which contracts need written consent. If any require amendments, we'll draft a short notice; PMs please review before sending.

Anya: Great progress. If no objections, we'll target a small canary (5 customers) for next week and expand after billing validation.

Raj: Sounds good. I can prioritize which 5 to pick based on low risk and contract flexibility.
